headSource: migration/evidence/NS01/c-freeze/prefreeze-audit.json; live git identity/index/class/target/protected/outside audits in phase C. Earlier runs immutable; no device actions or rebuild in C.

priorApprovedBaseline.policy: Human-accepted RN07 c02ae32 after clipboard-redaction history cleanup; current HEAD is safeguard commit, not the historical RN07 manifest HEAD.

decisions.summary: Pinned CLI npx --yes nativescript@9.1.2 via pinned Node; global CLI 8.9.2 untouched.
Exact vue-tsc@3.3.13; vue-tsc --noEmit checks Vue SFCs.
Exact vitest@5.0.5; one terminating pure TypeScript shell-content smoke test, not native rendering proof.
Reuse RN01_API36, app id dev.translationtest.ns; preserve RN client, no settings/Back/text input; only default light theme observed.
Retain template dependencies including Tailwind; remove only demo Details.vue route.

session.executor: Hermes GPT-6.1 Sol high / openai-codex / translation-migration, human-chosen
session.coordinator: Claude Code, live supervision and direct pixel inspection
session.phase: C: final static gates, handoff and revision 1 freeze only
session.stop: Next: none; STOP — NS02 requires a separate human assignment

environment.spawn: spawnSync argument arrays, shell:false; pinned Node first on child PATH; delete NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath case-insensitively

additions.licenseEvidence: Build stdout: Checking the license for package Android SDK Platform 36 ...; License for package Android SDK Platform 36 accepted.
additions.installationEvidence: 10-build-android.stdout.log reports preparing, installing and completing Android SDK Platform 36 (revision 2). Installed source.properties independently read: Pkg.Revision=2; AndroidVersion.ApiLevel=36.
additions.authorizationContext: NS01 step 8 permits a demonstrably required missing SDK platform with version/license recording. A4 also narrowly limits writes; disclose this automatic build side effect outside the target, rather than claiming all writes stayed inside the repo allowlist.

additions.evidence: 10-build-android.stdout.log reports download and unzip by Gradle wrapper.

environment.additionsDisposition: Coordinator accepted required Android SDK Platform 36 rev 2/license and Gradle 8.14.3 wrapper download under NS01 step 8.

coordinatorDispositions.summary: Human-authorized adb server restart before A2 resolved the blocked A1 read-only inventory; no restart in phase C.
coordinatorDispositions.authority: Coordinator dispositions supplied in phase C assignment

coordinatorDispositions.summary: Claude Code session variable NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath=1 broke gradlew.bat resolution in A2. A4 built with the variable removed process-locally and pinned Node first on PATH; no persistent environment or target edit.
A3 stopped at the coordinator's over-strict provenance gate because A2 lacked final target hashes. A4 used the A3 supervisor snapshot as expressly authorized; 71 target hashes match again in C.

A4 automatically installed Android SDK Platform 36 revision 2 (build-reported license accepted) and downloaded Gradle 8.14.3 wrapper cache. Coordinator accepts these environment additions under NS01 step 8; no rebuild or SDK work in C.

First phase B attempt was BLOCKED while emulator system_server was down and framework services were unavailable. Human authorized adb reboot before B2. This recovery is not a product fix; no device interaction in C.
coordinatorDispositions.authority: Coordinator dispositions supplied in phase C assignment

coordinatorDispositions.summary: B2 first-launch XML proof is missing and its 20942 ms polling exceeded the 20000 ms observation window. Coordinator pixels show the required shell on both cold launches; the second has XML plus pixels. Final B-launch PASS (coordinator pixels); observed Android launch satisfied. No XML or timing proof is invented, and B2 history remains BLOCKED.
